title: Me
simplified_paragraphs: 我从大学毕业以后，第一份工作是在公司里当职员，后来我发现生活太无聊了，整天坐在办公室里，所以我决定辞职。辞职以后我去了很多地方，开阔了视野，遇见了很多人，看到了很多风景。当我遇见我现在的丈夫，我知道是时候安定下来了，然后回家找了一份适合我的工作。
traditional_paragraphs: 我從大學畢業以後，第一份工作是在公司裡當職員，後來我發現生活太無聊了，整天坐在辦公室裡，所以我決定辭職。辭職以後我去了很多地方，開闊了視野，遇見了很多人，看到了很多風景。當我遇見我現在的丈夫，我知道是時候安定下來了，然後回家找了一份適合我的工作。
pinyin_paragraphs: wǒ cóng dà xué bì yè yǐ hòu， dì yī fèn gōng zuò shì zài gōng sī lǐ dāng zhí yuán， hòu lái wǒ fā xiàn shēng huó tài wú liáo le， zhěng tiān zuò zài bàn gōng shì lǐ， suǒ yǐ wǒ jué dìng cí zhí。 cí zhí yǐ hòu wǒ qù le hěn duō dì fang， kāi kuò le shì yě， yù jiàn le hěn duō rén， kàn dào le hěn duō fēng jǐng。 dāng wǒ yù jiàn wǒ xiàn zài de zhàng fu， wǒ zhī dào shì shí hou ān dìng xià lái le， rán hòu huí jiā zhǎo le yī fèn shì hé wǒ de gōng zuò。
english_paragraphs: After I graduated from college, my first job was as a clerk in a company. Later, I found that life was too boring, sitting in the office all day, so I decided to quit. After resigning, I went to many places, broadened my horizons, met many people, and saw many scenery. When I met my now husband, I knew it was time to settle down and go home and find a job that suited me.
english_full: After I graduated from college, my first job was as a clerk in a company. Later, I found that life was too boring, sitting in the office all day, so I decided to quit. After resigning, I went to many places, broadened my horizons, met many people, and saw many scenery. When I met my now husband, I knew it was time to settle down and go home and find a job that suited me.
